summary.text: Matthew Winslow is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 7 (Franklin and Vance counties), for the 2025-2026 session. The General Assembly's member page lists 3 terms served in the House. The page lists Matthew Winslow's leadership title as House Majority Conference Co-Chair.

paragraphs.text: The General Assembly's member page lists Matthew Winslow's occupation as Home Builder.
